source.name: World Happiness Report 2026, Data for Figure 2.1
source.publisher: Wellbeing Research Centre, University of Oxford; World Happiness Report
source.grain: country-year; three-year-average life evaluation and six explanatory factors

checks: 2,116 workbook records across 168 countries and 14 measured years
129 countries present in all 14 measured years
unweighted balanced-panel mean rounds to 5.47 in 2011 and 5.74 in 2025
2011 and 2025 score ranges round to 4.8 and 6.3
2011 bottom decile of 13 balanced-panel countries averages 3.80 in 2011 and 4.35 in 2025
gap between the fixed baseline bottom 13 and remaining 116 countries narrows from 1.86 to 1.54 points
2019 to 2025 correlations round to 0.70, 0.68, 0.66, and 0.04 for social support, GDP, health, and generosity
group gaps round to 0.83, 0.83, and 0.62 for GDP, social support, and health

evidenceBoundary: Descriptive country-level comparisons only. The balanced-panel mean is not population-weighted. Correlations and explanatory components do not identify policy effects.
